name: AUTH-SERVICE

sdk.dependencies: CPU-only; no private key, network, Redis, or web framework
sdk.compatibility: Existing AUTH-USER-SESSION v0.2 user verifier APIs remain unchanged; user and service tokens are separate.

jwt.subject: authenticated configured service id
jwt.kid: locally configured trusted public-key map; active signing key only on issuer; no remote key retrieval

errors.401: bad signature, type, audience, token structure, kid or time
errors.403: valid service token lacks a required permission

rotation: Configure overlapping public keys with one matching active private key; retire old kid only after tokens expire and all consumers reload.
